title: AIADRA event - part_changed (ADR/0029 Part authoring SCN arc 20260531-13)
description: Records additions / updates / removals to a Part's feature + geometry_ref namespaces. Emitted by Native Engine operations (e.g., aiadra-mechanical via ADR/0028 D16 namespaced operation kinds). Codex1 B1 absorption: uses the standard _base.schema.json envelope (schema_version, event_id, event_type, timestamp, transaction_id, actor, payload).

actor.description: Codex1 B1 + Codex1 B4 + Codex2 B1 absorption: narrowed from the base schema's `string minLength=1` to the closed enum required by ADR/0028 D8 provenance discipline; ALSO required at the part_changed root (the base schema treats actor as optional). Fold cross-checks every feature_delta operation's record.fact_provenance.category against this actor (agent -> ai_proposal; human -> human_input). A missing actor is schema-rejected (Codex2 B1).

rationale.description: Optional human-readable rationale for the change. Mirrors parameter_changed.rationale pattern.

feature_delta.description: Per ADR/0029 D3 + Codex1 B3 absorption: full add/update/remove delta semantics with atomic conflict rules enforced at fold time. Within ONE feature_delta: no duplicate ids in any single array; no id appears in more than one of added/updated/removed; added ids MUST NOT pre-exist; updated/removed ids MUST exist before the event; updated[].new_record.id MUST equal updated[].id. After applying the full delta atomically: no dangling depends_on_feature_ids or geometry_ref.derived_from_feature_ids references (cascade-rejects).

geometry_ref_delta.description: Per ADR/0029 D3 + Codex1 B3 absorption: same atomic conflict rules as feature_delta. After applying: no surviving geometry_ref's derived_from / derived_from_feature_ids may reference a removed id (cascade-rejects).
